content.title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

points: AV nodal ablation followed by pacemaker implantation can manage atrial fibrillation that does not respond to other treatments.
Different strategies and assessments have been listed for the management of atrial fibrillation through AV nodal ablation.

sections.section: 8.1 Goals of Therapy with Rhythm Control
points: Emphasizes importance of controlling heart rhythm to manage associated symptoms and improve patient outcomes.
